name: Via son Giachen
description_md:
The Via son Giachen is a waymarked hiking route in Switzerland that covers 261.1 km. It is classified as hard due to its distance and 10387 m of ascent.

The route requires 9599 m of descent and takes about 92 hours on the DIN 33466 hiking time rule. It is signposted as 43 and belongs to the regional waymarked hiking network. The line matches the official route published by swisstopo and passes within 500 m of Ruinaulta (Rhine Gorge).
